name: GTL Infrastructure Limited
about: GTL Infrastructure Limited, an independent and neutral telecom tower company, owns, builds, operates, and maintains telecom towers and related infrastructure, supporting multiple technologies including 2G, 3G, 4G, 5G, IoT, and enterprise data systems primarily in India. It provides telecom towers on a shared basis for telecommunications service providers to host their active network components; and delivers uninterrupted power on towers. The company was formerly known as GTL Infras Engineering & Managed Network Services Limited and changed its name to GTL Infrastructure Limited in February 2005. GTL Infrastructure Limited was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
